designationHistory.name: Carolina Sandhills Wildlife Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Franklin D. Roosevelt signed Executive Order 8067 establishing the Carolina Sandhills Wildlife Refuge on worn-out farmland the federal government had bought in Chesterfield County, South Carolina, under New Deal land programs.
designationHistory.note: A second order, Executive Order 8510 of August 8, 1940, established the Carolina Sandhills Wildlife Management Area (APP). Renamed Carolina Sandhills National Wildlife Refuge by Proclamation 2416 (July 25, 1940).
